facts.crew_assignment_rule: exact fit crew must be assigned from non-overlapping duty ledgers; company existence alone never crews a weapon
facts.weapon_id_rule: each installed weapon has stable ID derived from emplacement group plus three-digit index; reserve weapons receive an ID only when installed

standing_assignment.Red Crane Bed Crossbow Corps: all 320 installed bed crossbows at minimum crew when full emergency manning is ordered

standing_assignment.Red Crane Trebuchet Corps: all 48 installed trebuchets at minimum crew when full emergency manning is ordered

standing_assignment.White Lantern Stone-Drop and Firepot Cor: all 128 cranes and 128 cauldrons at minimum crew when full emergency manning is ordered

standing_assignment.Mu Zhen: overall contracted artillery and outer-defense command

records.label: emplacement_groups
notes: No weapon is considered crewed merely because a company exists. A combat event must assign exact fit crew and specialists from a non-overlapping duty ledger.
